_comment: Workflow DEFINITIONS for the flicker-widgets Workflow runtime (workflow.rs, loaded by `workflows_from_json`): `workflows.<name>` is one LINEAR wizard — a `title` ($token, the dispatch-card name) plus the ordered `steps` ({ id, title, needs, yields }). Branching is deliberately absent (Aaron, ratified 2026-08-01): a required branch is a SEPARATE definition here, chosen up front by the bench's dispatch — the asset-pipeline Task cards pick `import_character` for a declared Character (and the unclassified default) and `import_prop` for a Prop / Accessory / Animation, so the old in-spine 'skip Attach for a non-character' conditional is now simply a definition without the step. `needs`/`yields` name keys of the bench's per-frame step DOCUMENT (a key is present exactly when the scene state it names exists — flicker-assetpipeline `wf_doc`): `source` = an open scanned folder, `class` = the declared/effective AssetClass, `rig` = the character conform produced its `Rig`, `attach` = the authored attach-point set, `fit` = the prop/garment mount binding applies (a Clip-role animation lacks it, which is what stops the wizard at its unwired page), `committed` = the baked rig path. `Next` into a step whose needs are unmet refuses, fail-loud. Step `title` is the rail-chip label, a `$token` resolved through the stringtable at publish.
